title: Thai October headline CPI rises 3.90% on year, above forecast
summary: BANGKOK: Thailand’s headline consumer price index rose 3.90% in October from a year earlier, following an annual increase of 2.82% in the previous month, the commerce ministry said on Friday. The reading compared with a forecast rise of 3.24% in a Reuters poll, and exceeded the central bank’s inflation target range of 1% to 3%. The core CPI, which excludes volatile energy and fresh food prices, rose 1.58% in October from a year earlier.
